map.输入：年龄 30、静息心率 60。储备心率 HRR=220−30−60=130:
Input: age 30, resting heart rate 60. Heart rate reserve HRR=220−30−60=130 bpm.
Zone 2 (fat-burning base 60–70%): lower=130×0.6+60=138, upper=130×0.7+60=151 → 138–151 bpm.
Zone 4 (anaerobic threshold 80–90%): lower=130×0.8+60=164, upper=130×0.9+60=177 → 164–177 bpm.
Five zones: Z1 50–60%→125–138, Z2 138–151, Z3 151–164, Z4 164–177, Z5 177–190 bpm.

map.最大心率 220−年龄准吗？: Is maximum heart rate 220 − age accurate?
map.220−年龄是人群均值，个体差异±10–12 bpm；更准可用 Tanaka 2: 220 − age is a population average, with individual variation of ±10-12 bpm; the Tanaka formula 208 − 0.7×age is more accurate. This tool estimates the ceiling with 220 − age and uses resting heart rate for individualised zones.
